scenes.description: Listening Closely and Saying Can You Say That Again
Watching a Playful Kitten Dart Away across the Lawn
Nodding Warmly and Answering Yes of Course

character_line.en: A noisy truck drove past! Did you hear what I just said?
character_line.zh: 一輛好吵的卡車開過去了！你有聽清楚我剛才說什麼嗎？

options.en: Sorry, can you please say that again?
options.zh: 不好意思，你可以請你再說一次嗎？

options.hint: 請求再說一次可以用副詞「again（再一次）」喔！
有禮貌地請 Benny 再講一遍「say that again」！

character_line.en: Of course! I said: you are doing fantastic with your English!
character_line.zh: 當然可以！我是說：你的英文學得超級棒！

options.en: Thank you! I practice hard every single day!
options.zh: 謝謝你！我每天都好認真在練習！

options.hint: 開心接受讚美說「Thank you!」喔！
跟 Benny 分享你每天用功練習的好習慣！

character_line.en: Look at the garden path! Where did the playful little squirrel go?
character_line.zh: 看花園小徑！那隻調皮的小松鼠跑到哪裡去了？

options.en: It ran away and scampered up the tall pine tree!
options.zh: 牠跑遠了，而且竄到了高高的松樹上！

options.hint: 離開或跑向遠處用副詞「away」喔！
指出小松鼠跑開「ran away」爬上樹了！

character_line.en: It climbed so fast! Will it come back down to play?
character_line.zh: 牠爬得真快！牠等一下會不會再跑下來玩？

options.en: Maybe! If we stay quiet, it might come down!
options.zh: 也許會！如果我們保持安靜，牠可能會下來！

options.hint: 表示「也許、可能」可以用副詞「Maybe」喔！
猜想松鼠會不會下來，用「Maybe」回答吧！

character_line.en: Can you help me carry these drawing papers into the room?
character_line.zh: 你能幫我把這些畫紙搬進房間嗎？

options.en: Yes, of course! I am happy to help you!
options.zh: 當然好！我很樂意幫你的忙！

options.hint: 禮貌爽快地答應說「Yes, of course!」喔！
開心地答應 Benny 的請求幫忙搬畫紙！

character_line.en: Thank you so much! Smart replies make conversations so friendly!
character_line.zh: 非常謝謝你！聰明有禮的應答讓會話變得好親切！

options.en: You are welcome! Talking with you is always fun!
options.zh: 不客氣！跟你聊天總是這麼好玩！

options.hint: 回應別人的感謝說「You are welcome!（不客氣）」喔！
禮貌地回應不客氣，並期待下次聊天！
